We are a global manufacturer of construction materials and within our Group, our 41,500 team members in 90 countries across 300 sites provide a huge opportunity for anyone with ambition and energy. We value everyone's contribution equally and we ask that you bring your whole self to work, to enrich the business further, as together we achieve more in a safe and inclusive environment. Our global reach in 90 countries continues to grow and we are looking for passionate, ambitious people to help us achieve our goals. We are all led by the same core values and believe in the powerful potential of large companies to have a positive impact on the world. We are now looking for another team mate to join us in Suez Plant as Mechanical Technician . Can you say ‘yes’? Do you treat your colleagues with respect? Do you always have the customer in mind? Do you act with future generations in mind? Do you like to seek out opportunities to grow and develop? Do you have a proven track record of delivering results? What You’ll Be Doing Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance activities as scheduled by the maintenance planning team. Inspect plant equipment and operating systems, identify faults, and perform the necessary mechanical repairs. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to motors, pumps, conveyors and hydraulic systems. Execute maintenance tasks during planned overhaul shutdowns. Perform lubrication activities according to the approved lubrication plan. Monitor equipment condition and report abnormalities to the supervisor. Support the implementation of mechanical standards, procedures and controls to maintain high-quality maintenance work. Confirm completed jobs and report working hours accurately in the SAP system. Assist in checking and following up preventive maintenance plans to ensure timely execution. Support plant housekeeping and ensure cleaning procedures are properly followed in coordination with the Production team. Raise purchase requisitions for mechanical consumables and spare parts when required. Participate in plant improvement projects and yearly investment plan activities when assigned. Work closely with colleagues in the maintenance team and coordinate effectively with other departments. Follow all company safety rules, procedures and environmental requirements. What We’d Love For You To Have We are interested in you as a person: your attitude, behaviors and values. As long as you have the willingness to learn anything you need for the role that you don't already have, we'd love to speak to you. If you have experience in the following areas – this is an added advantage: Technical diploma or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Maintenance or a related field. Previous experience in mechanical maintenance within an industrial or manufacturing environment. Good practical knowledge of rotating equipment and mechanical systems. Experience in troubleshooting pumps, motors, conveyors and hydraulic systems is preferred. Familiarity with SAP or other maintenance management systems is an advantage. We’ll Provide A competitive salary Benefits What happens next? We appreciate that your time is precious and applying for a new job can be a lengthy process - so we have committed to replying to your application within 7 days Founded in 1932, Knauf is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of construction materials for interior design, building insulation, and design ceilings. Knauf entered the Middle East, Africa, and South Asia (MEASA) in 1997. Today, we are a leading player across the region, with operations spanning 15 countries and 19 state-of-the-art production facilities, driven forward by 2,000 high-performing professionals. Headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, MEASA's reach extends across Algeria, Cyprus, Egypt, the GCC, Ghana, Greece, India, Iraq, Kenya, Morocco, Nigeria, Tanzania, Tunisia, and Turkey. In MEASA, we offer the opportunity to be part of a global family of over 41,500 colleagues in 96 countries, who are dedicated to the same core values, and to a shared sense of purpose. We encourage all our people to shape their own career, with the freedom to stretch their skills and learn new ones. Driven by an unwavering commitment to quality, innovation and sustainability, we are building more than just exceptional gypsum-based solutions — we’re shaping a future we can all be proud of.

review_candidates.title: Lead Flight Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: About the Role We are seeking a Software Engineer to architect, develop, and own the onboard software stack for next-generation aerospace vehicles. You will work closely with Guidance, Navigation, and Controls (GN&C), avionics, and autonomy teams to design and implement real-time flight software responsible for mission sequencing, fault management, telemetry, and closed-loop control. Key Responsibilities Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of flight software subsystems including mode management, fault detection/isolation/recovery (FDIR), command and telemetry handling, and health monitoring. Work with G&C and avionics to integrate guidance, navigation, and control algorithms into real-time, resource-constrained environments using RTOS-based frameworks. Define and implement interfaces to sensors, actuators, and communication links (e.g., IMUs, RF links, propulsion, power systems) including low-level drivers and middleware. Develop and maintain simulation and test infrastructure, including software-in-the-loop (SITL), hardware-in-the-loop (HITL), Monte Carlo analysis, and recorded flight data playback to validate flight software performance and robustness. Own flight software reliability and safety: perform hazard analyses, define fault containment strategies, implement watchdogs, safe modes, and redundancy management. Collaborate with vehicle engineering to define software requirements, architecture documents, ICDs, and verification plans for flight-critical functionality. Lead code reviews, integration efforts, and debugging sessions on embedded targets with cross-functional teams (GN&C, avionics, payloads, ground software). Support integration and flight test campaigns, including pre-flight readiness, real-time telemetry monitoring, anomaly investigation, and post-flight data analysis. Mentor and guide junior flight software engineers, establish best practices for coding standards, testing, and configuration management for flight-critical systems. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree 5–10 years of experience designing, implementing, and testing embedded or flight software for aerospace, defense, or autonomous systems. Strong experience with C and/or C++ for embedded, real-time systems Hands-on experience developing software for microcontrollers or embedded processors, including working with RTOSes, interrupts, and hardware interfaces (e.g., UART, CAN, Ethernet). Demonstrated experience with software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop testing, including building and using testbeds and simulators for flight software validation. Preferred Qualifications Experience in flight software or safety-critical embedded systems for launch vehicles, spacecraft, UAVs, or advanced aerospace platforms. Experience integrating advanced GN&C algorithms into flight software, including MIMO feedback, trajectory following, and mission sequencing. Familiarity with aerospace software standards and processes (e.g., NASA/ESA standards, DO-178C, ECSS, or similar safety-critical frameworks). Experience with telemetry systems, ground software interfaces, and operational concepts for flight missions. Background in building and operating end-to-end mission software stacks, from embedded flight code to ground tools and monitoring systems. Experience with formal verification, static analysis tools, or rigorous validation approaches for high-reliability software.

review_candidates.title: HPC Systems Software Engineer – OpenCHAMI for Lugano or Zürich
review_candidates.company: Master in Integrated Building Systems ETH Zürich
review_candidates.description: 80%-100%, Lugano, fixed-term print Drucken The Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) develops and operates a high-performance computing and data research infrastructure that supports world-class science in Switzerland. Its user laboratory is available to domestic and international researchers in academia, industry, and the business sector. The centre is operated by ETH Zurich and has offices at its data centre in Lugano and in Zurich. Project background Project Overview OpenCHAMI stands for Open Composable Heterogeneous Adaptable Management Infrastructure . It is an open source project that provides modern system management and provisioning tools for High Performance Computing (HPC) clusters and supercomputers. The project with limited project financing and therefore limited contract duration aims to bring cloud-like deployment, automation, and security capabilities to HPC environments. This project with work location either Lugano or Zürich focuses on the development and advancement of OpenCHAMI for CSCS’s next-generation supercomputing infrastructure. The work will contribute to building an open, scalable, and modern approach to cluster management for large-scale High Performance Computing (HPC) systems. The main objective is to design, develop, integrate, and deploy OpenCHAMI capabilities tailored to the operational requirements of CSCS supercomputers. The project will address the challenges of managing increasingly complex HPC and AI systems and contribute to the evolution of next-generation open-source cluster management technologies. What We Value We value technical excellence, curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn and grow over a perfect checklist of skills. Working on next-generation HPC infrastructure requires a willingness to explore new technologies, tackle complex problems, and continuously develop new expertise. If you are motivated to make a meaningful impact in this area but do not meet every requirement, we strongly encourage you to apply. The Opportunity We offer an initially two-year contract providing the opportunity to work at the forefront of HPC and AI infrastructure at CSCS, contributing directly to the development of technologies that will support future supercomputing systems. You will have the opportunity to contribute to OpenCHAMI and related open-source initiatives, collaborating with the broader HPC community and contributing to high-impact programs at both the national and international levels, including HPSF, OpenCHAMI, and related initiatives. This is an opportunity to help shape how future CSCS supercomputers are managed, monitored, and operated, while contributing to open-source technologies with an impact well beyond a single system or institution. Job Description Develop and extend OpenCHAMI to meet the infrastructure management and operational requirements of CSCS’s current and next-generation supercomputing systems. Contribute to the OpenCHAMI open-source ecosystem, including the development, integration, and evolution of related cluster management services and components. Develop automation and management workflows to improve system provisioning, configuration, monitoring, maintenance, and operational efficiency at scale. Collaborate closely with HPC operations teams to understand operational requirements and challenges, and translate them into robust, scalable, and maintainable OpenCHAMI-based solutions. Contribute to the architecture and evolution of the OpenCHAMI platform, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, maintainable, and aligned with the needs of large-scale HPC and AI systems. Participate actively in open-source development workflows, including software design, implementation, testing, code reviews, issue tracking, and technical discussions within the OpenCHAMI community. Collaborate with international partners and the broader HPC community to develop and integrate solutions that advance open-source cluster management and infrastructure automation. Produce and maintain technical documentation, including architecture designs, implementation guides, operational procedures, and best practices. Evaluate emerging technologies and approaches relevant to HPC infrastructure management, observability, and automation, and contribute to their adoption where appropriate. Profile We welcome engineers with diverse backgrounds who are eager to contribute to our mission. We are primarily looking for strong technical foundations, sound engineering judgment, and the ability to bridge gaps across domains. Curiosity, adaptability, willingness to learn on the job, and potential to growthmatter more to us than a perfect initial match of technical requirements. The technologies listed below illustrate the breadth of our stack and areas of interest. They are not a checklist of requirements, and experience in only some of these areas is expected. Technical environment and areas of interest Go programming language Git and modern software development workflows CI/CD pipelines (Gitlab, GitHub, Ansible) Container technologies (Docker, Podman) Open-source software development Testing frameworks, software quality practices, and DevOps/GitOps approaches Personal Qualities Self-motivated, proactive, focused and collaborative Strong problem-solving mindset and comfortable tackling complex or ambiguous problems Clear communicator with a strong sense of user needs Open to learning new technologies and working across disciplines Comfortable asking for help and engaging the right expertise when needed Ways Of Working Ability to thrive in collaborative, self-organizing environments inspired by Agile principles Experience with structured development practices such as test-driven development is a plus Our Core Values As Guiding Principles Curiosity: You enjoy learning, exploring new ideas, and understanding problems deeply. Openness: You listen, collaborate, and are receptive to different perspectives. Courage: You tackle challenging or ambiguous problems and are willing to take initiative. Supportiveness: You help colleagues and users succeed and contribute to a positive team culture. Integrity: You act honestly, ethically, and reliably in your work. Workplace Workplace We offer We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive engineering team and particularly encourage applications from from groups underrepresented in tech. If you are technically strong, curious, and eager to grow, we want to hear from you. At CSCS, being family-friendly is much more than a label. We provide flexible and supportive working conditions that help employees manage both their careers and family responsibilities. For example, one of our Lugano buildings hosts a childcare facility, and we financially support up to three weeks of summer camp for primary school children. If your child is sick and you need assistance, we will even cover the cost of in-home childcare for our Lugano based employees. We are proud to be a genuinely family-friendly employer and are committed to supporting our employees when they need it most. You can look forward to an exciting working environment, cultural diversity and attractive offers and benefits. We value the diversity of our team and, to further enhance the diversity of our workforce, we particularly encourage women to apply. chevron_right Working, teaching and research at ETH Zurich We value diversity and sustainability In line with our values, ETH Zurich encourages an inclusive culture. We promote equality of opportunity, value diversity and nurture a working and learning environment in which the rights and dignity of all our staff and students are respected. Visit our Equal Opportunities and Diversity website to find out how we ensure a fair and open environment that allows everyone to grow and flourish. Sustainability is a core value for us – we are consistently working towards a climate-neutral future. Curious? So are we. Please Include The Following Documents With Your Application Motivation letter CV Relevant certificates and diplomas in pdf format We look forward to receiving your online application, including a letter of motivation, CV, diplomas, and employment certificates. Please address your application to Mrs Stephanie Frequente, CSCS Human Resources, Via Trevano 131, 6900 Lugano. Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through our online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered. Further information about CSCS can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Nur Fadel, nur.fadel@cscs.ch (no applications). For recruitment services, the GTC of ETH Zurich apply. About ETH Zürich ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities specialising in science and technology. We are renowned for our excellent education, cutting-edge fundamental research and direct transfer of new knowledge into society. Over 30,000 people from more than 120 countries find our university to be a place that promotes independent thinking and an environment that inspires excellence. Located in the heart of Europe, yet forging connections all over the world, we work together to develop solutions for the global challenges of today and tomorrow.
